target.title: fix(discord): limit implicit reply references to first chunk
target.body:
Closes #99068

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord users with `replyToMode: "first"` could receive one native reply notification per physical chunk when a single long agent reply was split into multiple Discord messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discord now carries a source-aware first-chunk-only flag from outbound delivery into the shared send layer. The flag is only enabled for implicit single-use reply targets, so explicit `[[reply_to_*]]` replies and all-mode replies keep their existing reusable native reply behavior while the implicit turn reply no longer fans out across every physical text or media-caption chunk.

The related open PR #99083 is not a strong blocker for this replacement shape: its current live review is still `status: needs proof` / `rating: unranked`, and ClawSweeper found that its mode-only suppression can break explicit first-mode chunk replies. This PR uses the reply source to avoid that compatibility regression.

## User Impact

Long Discord replies in first/batched implicit reply modes now quote the source message only on the first physical Discord message, avoiding repeated reply notifications for one logical answer. Explicit reply tags remain reusable across chunks as before.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: direct Discord send-layer request bodies only include `message_reference` on the first physical chunk when the outbound adapter marks the reply as implicit single-use, while default/direct sends still preserve reply references across chunks.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts --reporter=verbose` passed: 2 files, 85 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/outbound/message-plan.test.ts --reporter=verbose` passed: 1 file, 4 tests, confirming existing explicit-vs-implicit reply planning behavior remains intact.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/discord/src/send.shared.ts extensions/discord/src/send.outbound.ts extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.ts extensions/discord/src/send.sends-basic-channel-messages.test.ts extensions/discord/src/outbound-adapter.test.ts` passed.
- `node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=src-outside-plugin-sdk` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` exited 0 with no actionable output.

Not tested / proof gaps:

- I did not run a live Discord bot/channel scenario in this checkout because no live Discord credentials were available. The request-body proof exercises the real Discord send serialization boundary used by `createChannelMessage`.
